text.p: Following are some of the main stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
FINANCIEELE DAGBLAD
- Damages claim to be listed on Amsterdam bourse. (p1)
- Systems management firm Syllogic to apply for NASDAQ listing before seeking European quote. (p1)
- Building trade welcomes State Council decision in favour of rail link between Rotterdam and Germany. (p1)
- Last year's economic growth less dependent on consumer spending; investments playing more important role. (p1)
- Philips Electronics to cut 190 jobs at Belgian head office. (p3)
- Dairy firm Campina begins two-year restructuring at German unit. (p4)
- KLM Cargo to increase tariffs. (p4)
- Finance chief resigns at travel agent Travel Unie resigns. (p4)
DE VOLKSKRANT
- Vendex's department chain (V&D) maintains overtime bonuses in new three-year pay and conditions deal. (p2)
- ING clashes with New York City over local rates. (p2)
- Steel firm Hoogovens expects clarity today over possible deal with Belgium's Boel. (p15)
DE TELEGRAAF
- Plan for new sea-lock in IJmuiden to create thousands of jobs. (p1)
- Amsterdam Amstel Hotel's La Rive restaurant wins second Michelin star. (p1)
- Internet industry has created 4,000 Dutch jobs in last two years. (p22)
TROUW
- Utilities group EnergieNed to study possiblity of setting up electricty bourse. (p7)
- Postbank investment fund capital grew 40 percent to Dfl 5.25 billion last year. (p12)
